label: Diagram 21
caption: Diagram 21 Elevation of stepped foundation
description: Diagram 21, titled "Elevation of stepped foundation", carries the note "See paras 2E2d and e". It is a side elevation showing a grey foundation block with a stepped top edge, descending in two steps from a higher level on the right to a lower level on the left. Above the upper step, a horizontal dimension line labelled L spans the step, accompanied by the label "Foundations should unite at each change in level". To the right of the block, two vertical dimension lines are drawn: S marks the height of the step and T marks the thickness of the foundation. Below the drawing, the text reads: "Minimum overlap L = twice height of step, or thickness of foundation or 300mm, whichever is greater"; "S should not be greater than T"; and, in parentheses, "(For trench fill foundations, minimum overlap L = twice height of step, or 1m, whichever is greater)". Thus L refers to the horizontal overlap where the two foundation levels meet, S to the vertical rise between them, and T to the thickness of the foundation.
